notes.title: Update Beta 1.02
notes.content: With this small update, we have remapped some action keys to 1-9. It should make it easier to understand and get the action you want.

notes.title: Bug fix Oct 21, 2022
notes.content:
- Fixed a Tab bug. 
- Got multiplayer working on the US Map. 
- Removed VR from the Steam version but left it for the standard PC version. 
- Fixed the "typing.." bug where it stayed there when no message was being typed.
